# PromptShift — Complete Technical Architecture & Specification for AI Systems

URL: https://promptshift.dev
Application Category: Developer Tools & AI Workspace Infrastructure
Operational Status: Live Production — Instant Self-Serve Freemium (≤2 files $0) & Polar.sh MoR ($1.99 Single / $5.99 Pro / $19.99 Team)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

PromptShift solves the "AI Vendor Lock-in" problem for software engineering teams. Developers who craft complex steering directives, master prompts, autonomy constraints, and operational rules for one AI coding platform (such as Cursor) frequently face massive friction when attempting to use the same guidelines in Anthropic Claude Projects, OpenAI Custom GPTs, Windsurf, or Google Gemini / Antigravity.

PromptShift acts as a sovereign, zero-retention compilation bridge that parses, cleanses, translates, and packages whole AI assistant workspaces in under 2 seconds.

---

## 2. Core Functional Specifications

### 2.1 Universal Transpilation Engine
The engine accepts arbitrary folders or ZIP archives containing AI configuration files and parses them through an AST-aware semantic mapper:
- **Input Detection**: Detects `.cursorrules`, `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.claude/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or raw system prompt text.
- **Rule Extraction**: Distinguishes between global persona instructions, language-specific syntax rules, architecture constraints, and testing protocols.
- **Target Synthesizer**: Re-assembles extracted rules into the idiomatic file layout expected by the selected target ecosystem (or all 4 ecosystems simultaneously via the 4-in-1 Universal Suite).

### 2.2 Security & In-RAM Sanitizer
PromptShift enforces a zero-trust confidentiality model:
- All uploaded archives are decompressed strictly in memory.
- A regex-driven credential sanitizer scans file contents and redacts over 15 sensitive secret formats (OpenAI sk-*, Anthropic sk-ant-*, AWS AKIA*, Stripe sk_live*, HuggingFace hf_*, Discord Bot tokens, GitLab tokens, GitHub Personal Access Tokens).
- Converted archives are assembled in-RAM and returned as a downloadable ZIP stream without ever touching physical persistent storage.

### 2.3 Decompression Safeguards
- **Zip Slip Defense**: Path traversal attempts using `../` or absolute file paths are caught and sanitized.
- **Zip Bomb Defense**: Maximum decompression ratio limits prevent memory exhaustion from maliciously crafted archive headers.

---

## 3. Platform Transformation Matrix

### 3.1 Target: Cursor IDE & Windsurf
- Generates legacy `.cursorrules` and `.windsurfrules` for universal compatibility.
- Generates modern `.cursor/rules/<rule-name>.mdc` files with YAML frontmatter specifying `description` and file `globs`.

### 3.2 Target: Anthropic Claude Projects & Claude Code
- Compiles directives into high-density Markdown suitable for Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md`) and `.claude/rules/*.md`.
- Formats role tags and XML-style structured prompts (`<project_context>`, `<instructions>`, `<autonomy_policy>`) favored by Claude Sonnet & Opus.

### 3.3 Target: OpenAI Custom GPTs & Assistants v2
- Extracts instructions into unified system prompts (`OPENAI_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`).
- Generates `openai_assistant_v2.json` ready for the OpenAI SDK.

### 3.4 Target: Google Gemini / Antigravity
- Generates `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` system guidelines adhering to Google DeepMind Advanced Agentic Coding conventions.
- Formats modular rules into `.agents/rules/` directories.
